name: Says they still need 100 CP, software engineering track
description: First persona to exercise the CP-budget note (step 4/8, wired 2026-10-20). Software engineering's own 6 modules total 36 CP (6 modules times 6 ECTS, verified against the real recommend() output before writing this) -- far short of a stated 100 CP remaining, so the note must say this track alone doesn't cover it. Informational only: no module is excluded on this basis, since one track was never meant to be the student's entire remaining elective plan on its own (same framing rule_check.py's own area-requirement projection already uses).
